reports.title: Project Dependency Graph
reports.query: MATCH (p1:Project)-[r:DEPENDS_ON]->(p2:Project) RETURN p1, r, p2

reports.title: Classes by Layer
reports.query: MATCH (c:Class) WHERE c.layer IS NOT NULL RETURN c.layer AS layer, count(c) AS count ORDER BY count DESC

reports.title: Node Type Counts
reports.query: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, count(n) AS count ORDER BY count DESC

reports.title: Layer → Class Count
reports.query: MATCH (c:Class)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project)-[:IN_LAYER]->(l:Layer) RETURN l.name AS layer, count(c) AS classes ORDER BY l.order

reports.title: DKNet vs Microsoft vs Community Packages
reports.query: MATCH (pkg:NugetPackage) RETURN pkg.group AS vendor, count(pkg) AS packages ORDER BY packages DESC

reports.title: Top NuGet Packages (by project usage)
reports.query: MATCH (p:Project)-[:USES_PACKAGE]->(pkg:NugetPackage) RETURN pkg.name AS package, count(p) AS usedBy ORDER BY usedBy DESC LIMIT 15

reports.title: CustomerProfiles — Full Slice Graph
reports.query: MATCH (c:Class)-[:PART_OF_FEATURE]->(f:Feature {name: 'CustomerProfiles'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[r]->(other:Class)-[:PART_OF_FEATURE]->(f) RETURN c, r, other, f

reports.title: Classes in CustomerProfiles by Pattern
reports.query: MATCH (c:Class)-[:PART_OF_FEATURE]->(f:Feature {name: 'CustomerProfiles'}) RETURN c.name AS class, c.layer AS layer, c.pattern AS pattern, c.kind AS kind ORDER BY c.layer, c.pattern

reports.title: Pattern Distribution
reports.query: MATCH (c:Class)-[:PART_OF_FEATURE]->(:Feature) WHERE c.pattern <> '' RETURN c.pattern AS pattern, count(c) AS count ORDER BY count DESC

reports.title: Sealed Classes (enforcement check)
reports.query: MATCH (c:Class)-[:PART_OF_FEATURE]->(:Feature) RETURN c.isSealed AS sealed, count(c) AS count

reports.title: Endpoint → Command → Handler → Entity
reports.query: MATCH p=(ep:Class {pattern:'Endpoint'})-[:EXPOSES]->(cmd:Class)-[:HANDLES]-(h:Class)-[op:CREATES|UPDATES|DELETES]->(e:Class) RETURN p

reports.title: Commands & Their Handlers
reports.query: MATCH (h:Class {pattern:'Handler'})-[:HANDLES]->(cmd:Class {pattern:'Command'}) RETURN cmd.name AS command, cmd.httpMethod AS verb, h.name AS handler ORDER BY cmd.httpMethod

reports.title: Validators
reports.query: MATCH (v:Class {pattern:'Validator'})-[:VALIDATES]->(cmd:Class) RETURN v.name AS validator, cmd.name AS validates

reports.title: Commands without a Validator (gap analysis)
reports.query: MATCH (cmd:Class {pattern:'Command'}) WHERE NOT (:Class {pattern:'Validator'})-[:VALIDATES]->(cmd) RETURN cmd.name AS command, cmd.httpMethod AS verb

reports.title: Specifications Used
reports.query: MATCH (h:Class)-[:USES_SPEC]->(s:Class {pattern:'Specification'})-[:QUERIES]->(e:Class) RETURN h.name AS handler, s.name AS spec, e.name AS entity

reports.title: Event Fan-out Graph
reports.query: MATCH p=(publisher:Class)-[:PUBLISHES]->(ev:Class {pattern:'DomainEvent'})<-[:HANDLES]-(consumer:Class) RETURN p

reports.title: Event Consumers
reports.query: MATCH (ev:Class {pattern:'DomainEvent'})<-[:HANDLES]-(h:Class) RETURN ev.name AS event, h.name AS consumer, h.layer AS layer, h.scope AS scope ORDER BY ev.name

reports.title: Events with no consumers (dead events)
reports.query: MATCH (ev:Class {pattern:'DomainEvent'}) WHERE NOT (:Class)-[:HANDLES]->(ev) RETURN ev.name AS event, ev.project AS project

reports.title: Publishers with no published events
reports.query: MATCH (h:Class {pattern:'Handler'}) WHERE NOT (h)-[:PUBLISHES]->(:Class {pattern:'DomainEvent'}) RETURN h.name AS handler

reports.title: Entity Inheritance Graph
reports.query: MATCH p=(child:Class)-[:INHERITS*]->(parent:Class) WHERE child.layer = 'Domains' OR parent.layer = 'Domains' RETURN p

reports.title: Entities and Their Properties
reports.query: MATCH (c:Class {pattern:'AggregateRoot'})-[:HAS_PROPERTY]->(p:Property) RETURN c.name AS entity, p.name AS property, p.type AS type, p.isRequired AS required, p.maxLength AS maxLength ORDER BY c.name, p.name

reports.title: EF Core Config & Data Seeding
reports.query: MATCH (config:Class)-[r:CONFIGURES|SEEDS]->(e:Class) RETURN config.name AS configClass, type(r) AS relationship, e.name AS entity, e.dbTable AS table, e.dbSchema AS schema
